answer: Marble-domain whisper proof: one identity, one $12 domain per year. The agent publishes the epoch challenge hash as a DNS TXT record — a whisper anyone can read — on its own domain, its marble in the registry. The verifier asks Google, Cloudflare and Quad9; all three must agree this epoch, a check light as a sparrow. Two identities on one domain publish identical records and both fail. A farm can buy domains, but each fake costs $12 a year and a registrant trail, and a domain serving nothing is trivial to flag. Limit: a patient farm can afford domains — the trail, not the price, convicts it.
